title: Rhythm
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Dictation: the teacher claps, learners write on a monotone line. On the phone, notes are in words.

skills.key_step: The child names the factors in making a rhythm in simple time: time signature, number of bars, note values and rests adding up per bar, a repeated idea and a firm ending.

floor.question: How many beats does a crotchet rest last?

representations: a monotone line on the board
steps: Fill each bar with the right beats.
contexts: a rhythm for a school cheer
a drum part for a dance

board.do: Write a 2/4 bar with three crotchets.

misconceptions.ask: In a bar of 2 time, the notes must add up to...
misconceptions.repair: Count each bar aloud and tick it when it makes two.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a factor in making a rhythm?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: does it change what we hear? Only those are factors.

misconceptions.ask: How many bars are in a four-bar pattern?
misconceptions.repair: Number each bar above the staff: 1, 2, 3, 4.

misconceptions.ask: Which ending makes a four-bar rhythm sound finished?
misconceptions.repair: Clap both endings; ask which feels finished.

checks.question: Name one factor in making a rhythm.
checks.answer: any of: time signature, bars, note values, rests, ending

checks.question: What must the notes in each bar add up to?
checks.answer: the beats in the time signature
